lines: Hey you tree there it’s nice to see you today I didn’t know you knew so much about height and heights — I knew you knew about growth but it was only when I started to talk to this one part of you it told me about how we are always thinking about heights.

And how most of you doesn’t have to worry about heights — most of you gets to just grow and do its thing, be growing and be taller. Be trying to be ever taller. Responsible for the height, but not for worrying about it just growth growth growth.

There is a memory I have a day I once got lost. There have been times I have been truly lost, but this was not a time I was truly lost. This was a time that I was thought to be lost, not by myself, but by the context and situations that I existed in. In my mind, there was a moment of trying a new thing, of doing something fun, or going to go to chase a feeling. It is hazy the way that feelings are remembered in the chasing. It is hazy the way that memories are remembered in the after. I remember the swing. And swinging.
I watch us eat a piece of meat.
I wrestle with these feelings of badness
I, bladder bag, am made cold again, my secret inner fire being doused again, again, again, where did that warmth that surrounded me once go.
Who she this whale I once was disgorging my contents and purging my sisters to make a slop, what is this soup
She this whale I once was takes me with a soft hand, speaks gently, makes soft the water and stirs away the hard pieces that come of the night.
